notes: GEO ACCESSION: GSE243674 (Homo sapiens, GPL21697 NextSeq 550; featureCounts gene-level counts on hg38). Series title: 'Anthracyclines induce cardiotoxicity through a shared gene expression response signature' (PMID 38416769). The only stored source file is GSE243674_Counts_RNA_ERMatthews.txt.gz: an ENTREZID x 72-well space-delimited count matrix (28,395 Entrez rows, 72 wells = 6 healthy female hiPSC-CM donors x 6 arms x 2 time points). ARMS: the matrix header tokens are DNR/DOX/EPI/MTX/TRZ/VEH (12 wells each); they were expanded to daunorubicin/doxorubicin/epirubicin/mitoxantrone/trastuzumab/vehicle from the GSE243674 series-matrix metadata (!Sample_characteristics_ch1 'treatment: 0.5 uM ...' and !Series_overall_design), fetched only to verify the labels and NOT stored in source/ — the abbreviations are what this item's own download carries. treatment is 0.5 uM for all agents, 3 h and 24 h. MAPPING: ENTREZID -> HGNC symbol with the pinned pert_data/Annotation/source/hgnc_complete_set.txt (16,982,321 B, sha256 12363916be36f8f6f91879b0faade4eeaac973722de7136ec61329b77f2c2f91; 44,497 approved rows). 26,867 of 28,395 Entrez IDs mapped; 1,528 lost (0.154% of reads); 1 one-to-many Entrez ID in this matrix (100874204 -> ALDH1L1-AS1 vs SLC41A3-AS1, resolved to ALDH1L1-AS1 by protein-coding < non-coding RNA < pseudogene < other, then lowest hgnc_id); 0 duplicate symbols collapsed; 1,769 mapped genes have zero counts in all 72 wells (kept, NA statistics). DEG: DESeq2 per drug x time vs vehicle at the same time point (12 wells: 6 drug + 6 vehicle, same 6 donors), design ~ donor + group (paired donor term), Wald test with unshrunken MLE log2FoldChange, BH padj, DESeq2 default independent filtering at alpha 0.05; no L1000 or expression filter; 26,867 genes tested per contrast; n_up/n_down at padj<0.05 and |log2FC|>0.5. Expression matrix: log2(CP10K+1), CP10K on the mapped-gene library size, 4 decimals, 26,867 genes x 72 wells; local/expr/GSE243674_samples.csv has one row per well in matrix column order with drug tokens dnr/dox/epi/mtx/trz/veh and group treated/vehicle. Gene set of the expression matrix equals the DEG gene set by construction (same pinned mapping rule in both scripts). DIGESTS: source 4b51a5a2458ffc56c0fe15d07243a796d461ec6306bd44c6d0aab4f46ac40882; manifest/tree_sha256 6ed672359b0db3974a35c532cb503ab3ddb75cfdf7dedf286cc357b5967a341a; deg CSV 0ff8716bf12b0dde9fb4160c01dd4beb58af0e9114e2e45933ec200430e7cf8c (268,670 rows); log_expr 074142d8cec91947ae1056619e8c8a2ae2ad4024d12fba0385299c8050c90907; samples.csv fe454e4cf94ef77e03bd167340dc62ca6f69fdf6bf6e326649869a8134ac2907; helpers map_to_human.R b90b96be8dd6b6ab7abd5b7547345a4d9bd50c0b5e41d3309ba8ca037873f91a and map_orthologs.R 2306f1021931aa3a56557294530fd33a08957174b085ab8cc7a847f19fb4cf5f (byte-identical to disease_data/GSE160516/script/). BUILD: pinned R /home/chang/miniconda3/envs/biomni_e1/bin/Rscript (R 4.5.3, DESeq2 1.x), ulimit -v 6G, OMP_NUM_THREADS=2; peak RSS build_deg.R 1,085,564 KiB (max of two runs: 1,084,448 / 1,085,564 KiB, ~1.04 GiB), wall 54-59 s; build_expression.R 193,796 KiB, wall 1.4 s. REPRODUCTION: re-running build_deg.R reproduces the deg CSV sha256 above (and therefore the pinned deg JSON counts); the expression build is deterministic on the same R. In a checkout (worktree) where the gitignored pert_data/Annotation/source/ tree is not materialised, point ARC_HGNC_TABLE at a materialised copy; the canonical default is the repo-relative pinned path used above.
